text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: <chrname> seems to have suffered a minor injury...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, right now we are in the middle of 
an important expedition. Now then, what 
should we do—
choice_data_list: Make sure she gets proper rest

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decided to have her focus completely on 
treatment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> couldn't move her body and seemed to be 
feeling a bit down...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decided to give <chrname> some passionate 
encouragement and urge her to do her best—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, it ended in failure! It seems the 
injury has worsened even further...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, miraculously, the injury healed 
completely as well, and training went 
great!!
